STEP 6 (Search budget gating) — PASS — /api/buyer/search?budgetOnly=true returns budgetGuarded:true and zero vehicles > $35k.

Plural alias re-export confirmed working.
STEP 11 (Dealer offers list) — PASS — sandbox-dealer signin OK, /api/dealer/offers returns ≥1 offer.

Iter14 returned 400 AUCTION_NOT_CLOSED — now fixed.

STEP 13 (Buyer selects offer) — PASS (via seed) — Seed script directly links rank-1 offer to deal. Did not POST select-offer this iteration to preserve the ACTIVE auction for steps 12 and 18 (per seed CAUTION note).
STEP 14 (Plan-based fee) — PASS — STANDARD $0 / PREMIUM $400 confirmed via plan/upgrade idempotency edge case.
STEP 15 (Insurance mock) — PARTIAL — Endpoint reachable from iter13; not re-exercised this iteration.

Iter14 returned score=100 — now fixed.
STEP 17 (DocuSign envelope POST) — PASS — returns mock {envelopeId:'mock-envelope-id', signingUrl:'#docusign-sandbox-mock', mock:true}.
STEP 18 (Pickup QR generation) — PASS — POST /api/buyer/pickup/{dealId}/qr returns 200 {qrToken (48 chars), qrCodeBase64 starts with data:image/, expiresAt}.

STEP 19 (Dealer scans QR → COMPLETED) — PASS — POST /api/dealer/pickup/scan with {qrToken} from step 18 → 200 {success:true, dealId, completedAt}. Invalid token → 422 INVALID_TOKEN. Re-scan same token → 409 ALREADY_SCANNED. Iter14 BLOCKED — now fixed.
STEP 20 (Receipt page) — PASS — GET /api/buyer/deals/{dealId}/receipt returns 200 after step 19 transitions deal.status to COMPLETED. Iter14 BLOCKED — now fixed.
STEP 21 (Journey navigator presence) — PASS — data-testid='journey-navigator' visible on /buyer/auction/{id} AND /buyer/auctions/{id} (newly accessible). Already PASS on /buyer/dashboard.

minor.issue: Cosmetic: the BUILTIN_ADDON_PACKING fixList entry for 'Etch warranty' shows amount:'$899' / foundValue:'Etch warranty: $899' even though the input text said $499. The dollar-amount regex appears to be greedy/picking up the doc-fee value instead of the etch-warranty value. Score and rule firing are correct; only the displayed amount is wrong. Suggest scoping the dollar-amount capture to a window near the matched keyword.

action_items: Optional polish: tune scanContract heuristic to capture the correct dollar amount per rule match (etch warranty currently shows $899 instead of $499). Score and FAIL state are correct; only the amount label is mis-attributed.
EDGE 2 session-expiry modal Playwright test still deferred (3 iterations now).
critical_code_review_comments: /api/dealer/pickup/scan implementation is solid: checks pickup exists, dealer ownership (offer.dealerId === dealer.id), expiry, and ALREADY_SCANNED, then prisma.$transaction updates pickup+deal+activity event. Resend email is best-effort with .catch. Status codes per spec (422 INVALID_TOKEN, 409 ALREADY_SCANNED, 200 success).

/api/buyer/auctions/[auctionId]/best-price now allows ACTIVE auctions and emits preliminary:true with the exact spec label. CLOSED would emit preliminary:false / no label. Empty-offer ACTIVE path returns offers:[] + message:'No offers yet'. Clean.
/buyer/auctions/[auctionId]/page.tsx alias re-exports the singular component, so they share the same UI tree (countdown, journey-navigator, offer-count poll). No duplication.
Disk pressure note: /app .next/dev/cache cleared once during this iteration before yarn sandbox:seed-deal. Free space healthy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 previously-BLOCKED steps are now GREEN. The pickup-scan flow is irreversible: once a buyer's QR is scanned by the dealer, the deal is COMPLETED and you cannot re-test step 12 (best-price ACTIVE) or step 19 without running yarn sandbox:seed-deal again. rca_of_the_issue: All 5 fixes from main agent verified in production preview: (1) plural alias /buyer/auctions/[id]/page.tsx re-exports singular page so countdown UI shared. (2) best-price loosened gate: status==ACTIVE now returns ranked offers with preliminary:true + label. (3) /api/dealer/pickup/scan validates qrToken via Pickup.qrCodeData lookup, dealer ownership, expiry; transitions pickup+deal to COMPLETED in single $transaction. (4) scanContract.service detects DOC_FEE_CAP_CENTS=$150 and ADDON_PACKING_CAP_CENTS=$300 keywords (documentation fee, etch warranty, mandatory etch) — score=44 for the spec-test text. (5) journey-status wrapped in try/catch + extended state mapping returns 200 with currentStage.
